subject: Renewal discussion: capacity uplift, term options, and fiscal safety net
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nimbushealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal discussion: capacity uplift + term options

Hi Logan,

Hope you’re well — we’re starting planning for FY27 and want to formalize our Redwood renewal. Quick summary of what we need to cover:
- Uplift from current Dedicated capacity by ~2.5x across peak months (Q1-Q2).
- Consider multi-year term (24 months) vs keeping usage-first with volume commit.
- Co-terming across three BU contracts (CareOps, Analytics, Platform) so Finance can harmonize billing.
- Procurement prefers a split-prepay (50% upfront, remainder quarterly) but finance will consider alternatives.

Attached is our current usage export and a short internal ask list (current_usage_report.csv). Our goal is to sign by Dec 15 to hit Jan onboarding windows. Can you outline options (pricing/term/implementation runway) and a suggested mutual action plan?

Appreciate it —
Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Platform Ops, Nimbus Health
olivia.park@nimbushealth.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion: capacity uplift + term options

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear brief and the usage file.

Short answer up front: we can do both a multi-year committed option (24 months with stepped ramp) and a commit-plus-usage hybrid. High-level options I recommend we review:
1) 24-month staged-commit: upfront discount tier (6% blended) with milestone unlocks at 6/12/18 months to reach full 2.5x capacity.
2) 12-month flex + true-up: lower commitment floor, higher token rates above threshold, quarterly true-ups.
3) Dedicated pool with canary routing: start with CareOps for 30 days, then lift Analytics/Platform after canary success — reduces risk while preserving performance SLAs.

Camila (cc) will assemble a mutual action plan and a draft pricing matrix. Kimberly, can you flag any billing constraints with split-prepay?

I’m available for a 30m call on Mon 16th or Tue 17th — what works for your procurement team?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nimbushealth.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan & pricing snapshot (initial)

Hi Olivia — good to meet yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m sending an initial Mutual Action Plan and the pricing snapshot we discussed.

Key MAP items (high level):
- Week 1 (Dec 1): Finalize term selection (24mo staged or 12mo flex) and sign SOW.
- Week 2 (Dec 6–10): Finance to provide PO or approve split-prepay cadence.
- Week 3 (Dec 13–20): Implementation kickoff — Jonas to run canary with CareOps team.
- Week 6 (Jan 15): Full uplift live for agreed BUs, monitoring SLA for 30 days, rollback plan defined.

Pricing snapshot attached (Pricing_Matrix_Nimbus_2027.xlsx). Notes:
- For the 24mo staged-commit we modeled a 6% blended discount if Nimbus commits to the 2.5x target by month 18.
- Prepay split options: 50/50 upfront/quarterly; or 30/70 with slightly smaller discount.
- We included a conservative burst buffer (15%) for Q1 to avoid immediate overage.

Jonas will own the technical runbook and will coordinate the canary timeline. Kimberly, any initial flags on invoicing cadence or compliance that would prevent a Dec sign?

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_Nimbus.docx, Pricing_Matrix_Nimbus_2027.xlsx

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
From: Rajesh Gupta <r.gupta@nimbushealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & pricing snapshot (initial)

Camila — thanks for the MAP and pricing. A couple of procurement/finance points from our side: 
- Nimbus prefers a split-prepay not exceeding 60% upfront. We’d like to avoid a full 50% if there's not sufficient proof of performance for the uplift.
- Can you provide an implementation SLA addendum and example audit logs (SOC2 evidence + request for sample retention policy)? Procurement will need this before executing a PO.
- For cohort co-terming: our legal team needs a single umbrella SOW with BU-specific exhibits so internal chargebacks work.

Attached: Nimbus_PO_template.pdf (procurement). If you can incorporate an SLA addendum and provide the SOC2 summary and a proposed invoice schedule by Nov 24, we can route the PO through Legal for a Dec 7 approval meeting.

Regards,
Rajesh Gupta
VP Finance (Nimbus Health)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@nimbushealth.com>, Rajesh Gupta <r.gupta@nimbushealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & pricing snapshot (initial) — next steps + docs

Thanks Rajesh / Olivia — we can accommodate the split-prepay cap at 60% and will provide the SLA addendum + SOC2 summary this week. Attached are the renewal template and a proposed invoice schedule for your review: Nimbus_Renewal_Template_v3.pdf.

Next steps:
- Today: I’ll upload the DocuSign envelope for the 24mo staged-commit option (includes umbrella SOW + BU exhibits) — link below.
- Tomorrow: Jonas will schedule the canary runbook review with your platform engineers (target Jan 4 kickoff).
- By Dec 7: Kimberly and our finance team to finalize invoice cadence with Nimbus Procurement.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/NIM-2026-EXPAND-01
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Attachments: Nimbus_Renewal_Template_v3.pdf
